matrix_population.description: saved population: all, any-significant or significant:<measurement>

matrix_order.description: shared row order: saved, identity or supported reference period

matrix_reference.description: saved measurement used for explicit period ordering

matrix_representation.description: saved values: raw, filtered or detrended

matrix_scale.description: explicit Workbench display normalization method or none

matrix_rows.description: maximum cells per recording page, shared across measurements

matrix_metrics.description: saved measurements to show; empty includes all

matrix_page.description: one-based page of saved time matrices

evidence_page.description: one-based page of saved selected-cell evidence

report_measurements_per_page.description: maximum significant measurements per cell report page

grid_cells_per_page.description: maximum cells per complete measurement grid page

cells_per_page.description: maximum selected relationship cells per complete report page

reverse_cells.description: reverse the complete saved report cell order (true/false)

display_lag_range_hours.description: two physical hours limiting display of a complete saved lag search

population_groups_per_page.description: maximum complete saved sample/recording groups per population page

grid_rows.description: rows in an all-cell trace grid; unset computes a compact grid

trace_normalization.description: Workbench normalization applied separately to each cell and measurement; none keeps original units

trace_normalization_config.description: JSON object of Workbench normalization arguments

overview_page.description: one-based page of the complete saved rhythm screen

overview_rows.description: maximum cells per overview matrix page; preserves all requested cells

matrix_block_size.description: maximum measurement rows and columns per relationship matrix page

summary_level.description: saved relationship summary to display: all_cells or across_samples

measurement_order.description: comma-separated order containing every requested relationship measurement

state_page_size.description: maximum saved support criteria per state diagnostic page

state_feature_page_size.description: maximum original-unit measurements per accepted-state profile page

state_display_order.description: comma-separated order containing every accepted saved state ID

state_display_names.description: JSON object mapping accepted state IDs to display labels

state_cells_per_page.description: maximum original-clock cell timelines per page

state_cell_order.description: JSON list containing every complete source/movie/cell key in display order

state_show_membership.description: show saved model-conditional component membership below timelines (true/false)

state_summary_cells_per_page.description: maximum cells per saved state time summary page

state_summary_columns_per_page.description: maximum states or state pairs per saved state matrix page

state_summary_views.description: comma-separated saved state views: occupancy, switch_rates, transitions, bouts, samples, contrasts

state_sample_questions_per_page.description: maximum experimental-unit questions per saved state sample page

state_contrasts_per_page.description: maximum saved state condition contrasts per page

state_card_features.description: comma-separated saved feature names to show on accepted-state cards

state_card_features_per_page.description: maximum original-unit feature profiles per state card page

state_card_low_membership.description: include an explicitly labelled low-membership assigned example (true/false)

state_card_images.description: include exact-observation source imagery on state cards when available (true/false)

audit_candidates.description: saved complete candidate ids to display; empty includes all

audit_facet.description: saved benchmark stratum: periods, waveforms, noise, span_hours, source_profile_id or scenario

audit_page.description: one-based page of the saved audit view

audit_page_size.description: maximum displayed cell or stratum rows per page

audit_case_ids.description: manual saved case ids, each including movie, cell and measurement

audit_examples_per_reason.description: focused examples per measurement and inspection reason

audit_seed.description: seed for deterministic display-only example ordering

spatial_metric.description: numeric metric mapped through space; radial_occupancy is a derived shortcut

reference_metric.description: numeric reference metric for within-cell timing comparisons

snapshot_hours.description: recording hours to draw; nearest actual frames, no interpolation

snapshot_count.description: number of snapshots: 1 shows the final frame (default); explicit snapshot_hours take precedence

show_history.description: show the complete time trace instead of only selected snapshots

spatial_axis.description: physical coordinate used to order cells: x or y

spatial_centre.description: position and optional displacement use soma or centroid

spatial_panel_inches.description: minimum width of each spatial panel in inches

spatial_point_size.description: area of a cell-position marker in points squared

spatial_annotate.description: label cell-position markers with their identities

spatial_arrows.description: overlay displacement since the preceding consecutive frame

spatial_tracks.description: overlay recorded cell paths on the detected-period map

spatial_track_cells.description: which tracks to show: rhythmic (default) or all

spatial_cmap.description: colour map for the selected spatial values

phase_group_hours.description: centres of period groups for separate peak-time maps; empty shows peak percentage for every significant cell with an available estimate

period_tolerance.description: largest relative period difference for a timing comparison

timing_reference_hour.description: recording hour at which relative phase is compared

spatial_neighbours.description: nearest neighbours per cell; symmetric union defines the spatial graph

spatial_permutations.description: whole-trace spatial permutations for the field-level comparison

spatial_seed.description: reproducible seed for spatial permutation tests

max_inferred_fraction.description: exclude cell-frame metrics above this tracker-reconstructed pixel fraction

stem.description: which movie in the run to draw, when the run holds more than one

item.description: which item of the run's plot plan to draw; see `python -m analysis plots <run> --dry-run` for the names

hour_ticks.description: hours between ticks on a time axis; a factor or multiple of 24

metrics.description: which measured columns the figure draws, comma separated; see its docstring

display.description: which representation of the selected measurement is drawn

hues.description: colours for named groups, comma separated in the figure's displayed order

event_metric.description: which measured column ranks the frames used as alignment events

event_direction.description: how event frames are ranked: high values, low values, or within-cell deviation

top_events.description: number of top-ranked frames retained per cell

events.description: names for user-selected events, comma separated

event_times.description: start time of each user-selected event window, in hours

images.description: how many image tiles across the top; 0 for none

image_hours.description: explicit hours for the image tiles, comma separated; beats --images

cell_lut.description: colour map for cell images, e.g. dluc_purple, magma, gray

image_filter.description: display-only image denoising: auto-organotypic or none

display_black_percentile.description: percentile of the mean image mapped to the display floor

display_white_percentile.description: percentile of the image stack mapped to the display ceiling

display_range_scope.description: frames used to choose the shared image display range

display_gamma.description: display tone-curve exponent; below 1 lifts dim detail

display_gain.description: display-only multiplier for frame departures from their mean

display_spatial_sigma.description: display-only Gaussian smoothing width in pixels

display_pool_px.description: spatial pooling width for adaptive display denoising, in pixels

display_sharpness.description: sharpness of the adaptive display denoising transition

display_noise_multiple.description: noise-floor multiplier used by adaptive display denoising

display_pad_frames.description: mirrored frames at each end of adaptive display denoising

trace_luts.description: colour or colour map per trace, comma separated, matched to --metrics

map_luts.description: colour map per canonical spatial panel, comma separated in panel order

matrix_lut.description: colour map used for numeric values in a matrix

column_label_rotation.description: rotation of matrix column labels in degrees

column_label_wrap.description: maximum characters per matrix column-label line; 0 disables wrapping

map_summary.description: how a per-frame metric becomes one value per cell: median, mean, minimum, maximum, first, or last

map_assignment.description: overlapping cell values: occupancy_weighted_mean (default), equal_mean, first, last, or most_frequent

phase_coherence.description: minimum circular agreement for a phase-map mixture or tissue reference, 0 to 1

map_range.description: colour limits for each spatial metric: robust percentiles or the full observed range

density_lut.description: colour map used for observation density

density_summary.description: summary over a density map: mean or none

trace_view.description: trace values shown: raw or detrended

period_testing.description: run and show the per-cell period tests (true/false)

fft_component_test.description: Use the median3 then mean3, robust-linear and FFT-NLLS component test for cell-grid rhythm calls; false restores the selected periodogram test.

component_surrogates.description: Number of four-hour block-residual surrogate traces used to test each fitted FFT component.

component_block_hours.description: Duration in hours of intact residual blocks shuffled by the FFT component test.

component_seed.description: Base random seed for the deterministic FFT component surrogate test.

outline.description: colour of the outline drawn over each image tile

fit.description: which traces carry the fitted curve: a metric list, all, or empty for none

multiple_testing.description: correction across a family of rhythm tests: bh, bonferroni, sidak or none

correction_scope.description: multiple-testing family: every matrix cell together or each metric column separately

min_observations.description: fewest measured timepoints required before a trace is tested

min_cycles.description: fewest observed cycles required to treat a detected period as well constrained

median_window_points.description: odd median-window width in sampling intervals; missing rows and long gaps split the filter

panels.description: which panels of a multi-panel figure to draw, comma separated

bins.description: how many bands a histogram panel divides its range into

profile_bins.description: how many equal positions a detected cycle is divided into for comparison

size.description: which column sets point size on a scatter; empty for one size

line_width_metric.description: which per-cell numeric column sets trajectory line width; empty for one width

line_width_range.description: smallest and largest widths as multiples of the default trajectory width

line_dash_metric.description: which per-cell column sets trajectory dashes; rhythm_period_band uses rhythm results

cells.description: which identities appear, comma separated, or how many longest-lived cells

crop_padding.description: empty border around an image crop as a fraction of the measured object span

quantile.description: data quantile used to define an event threshold

window.description: frames either side of an aligned event

max_lag.description: largest lag drawn, in frames unless the figure says hours

order.description: row ordering used by a raster or ribbon

max_cells.description: most lanes drawn, cells with an event first; 0 draws every cell

max_families.description: most families drawn on the lineage panel; 0 draws every one

lineage.description: join a parent's lane to a daughter's first frame (true/false)

show.description: which lifecycle events a panel counts, comma separated

bin_hours.description: width of one bin on an hours axis

show_censored.description: include the recording's own start and end as events (true/false)

timing.description: which precomputed timing column or figure alias is distributed

period_hours.description: cycle length used to wrap phase displays, in hours

period_bins.description: period-band boundaries in hours, comma separated

regime.description: regime number used for a within-cell contrast

contour.description: occupancy-frequency contour as a share of observed frames

coverage_view.description: coverage map shown: final or stages

stages.description: number of evenly spaced recording stages

thresholds.description: core and transient cut-offs, comma separated

scaling.description: which ring width to read: cell or global

annulus_support.description: smallest observable fraction of every radial annulus required for a frame

threshold.description: data quantile used as a recurrence cut-off

clusters.description: number of sequence groups cut from a clustering tree

dilation.description: one or two contact radii in pixels, comma separated

min_hours.description: minimum contact duration retained, in hours

max_pairs.description: maximum longest-contacting pairs shown in a pair ledger; 0 shows all

rhythm_metric.description: measurement whose rhythm result is compared between cells

min_coverage.description: least share of a window a cell must be observed in before its windowed summary is drawn

min_contested.description: minimum number of identities that must claim a contested pixel

inferred_threshold.description: share of an outline whose ownership must be reconstructed before the frame is drawn as reconstructed; 0 means any at all

header_x.description: left edge of the title, subtitle and footnote

title_y.description: title, measured down from the top edge

subtitle_y.description: subtitle, measured down from the top edge

footnote_y.description: footnote, measured up from the bottom edge

fit_method.description: Single period estimator requested by estimate_period; independent of the periodogram used for a rhythmicity verdict.

period_methods.description: Estimators requested by `compare_periods`; the default runs Lomb-Scargle only.

significance_method.description: Significance test, selected separately from period estimation.

secondary_significance_method.description: Significance test, selected separately from period estimation.

period_min_hours.description: Shortest candidate period in spectral and instantaneous-phase searches.

period_max_hours.description: Longest candidate period in spectral and instantaneous-phase searches.

rhythmic_alpha.description: Explicit threshold also supplied to rank tests and family correction.

detrend.description: Baseline-removal method applied before extended period estimation.

detrend_window_hours.description: Biological-time window for local baseline removal before period estimation; not a period search bound.

detrend_polynomial_degree.description: Polynomial degree used when period detrending is polynomial.

detrend_min_valid_fraction.description: Minimum valid fraction required inside a detrending window.

detrend_bandwidth_hours.description: Kernel bandwidth used by kernel baseline detrending.

detrend_low_cut_hours.description: Longest period retained by frequency-filter detrending.

detrend_high_cut_hours.description: Shortest period retained by frequency-filter detrending.

detrend_filter_order.description: Digital-filter order used by frequency-filter detrending.

detrend_lowess_fraction.description: Finite-record fraction used by each LOWESS local fit; null derives it from the detrending window.

detrend_lowess_iterations.description: Robust residual-reweighting passes used by LOWESS detrending.

detrend_asls_smoothness.description: Second-difference smoothness penalty used by asymmetric least-squares detrending.

detrend_asls_asymmetry.description: Weight given to points above an asymmetric least-squares baseline.

detrend_asls_iterations.description: Reweighting passes used by asymmetric least-squares detrending.

detrend_methods.description: Baseline-removal method applied before extended period estimation.

period_config.description: Partial scientific settings. Omitted or None values use the shared installed defaults; invalid fresh values are rejected. Run describe_config for names, meanings, units, bounds and choices. Explicitly load old saved mappings with load_saved_settings to report compatibility conversions.

overlay.description: Draw categorical outlines or occupancy colours over the recorded raw image.

descriptive_cosinor.description: Draw an explicitly requested descriptive cosine at the selected estimated period; it supplies no selected period or rhythm verdict.

ring_count.description: number of Sholl rings retained for display

transition_normalisation.description: matrix normalisation: row, column or none
